# It's Trending Global

> Free AI tools from GitHub and the AI news that matters, explained simply. Plain-English guides to free GitHub AI tools, monthly AI news and weekly trending repos, with install steps and FAQs.

## Free AI tools

- [VoiceStudio: Free ElevenLabs Alternative (2026 Guide)](https://itstrendingglobal.pages.dev/tools/debpalash-voicestudio): VoiceStudio is a free ElevenLabs alternative. Clone a voice, dub videos and turn text into speech on your own Mac, Windows or Linux computer.
